messages:
sophia_partnerships: FYI — ACMECloud private offer PO stuck in marketplace validation. Portal says signer/entity mismatch, buyer signed as 'ACME Cloud Services' but PO billing entity is 'ACME Cloud LLC'. Need help unblocking procurement. PO: PO-94321
james_fpna: Can you paste the portal error & PO header? I can triage with finance.
marketplace-bot: Automated check: PO validation failed — seller_billing_entity != seller_account_name. Error code: MKT-ENT-409
sophia_partnerships: copied error. PO header:
```
PO-ID: PO-94321
Buyer: ACME Cloud Services
Billing Entity: ACME Cloud LLC
Seller: Redwood Inference Inc
Seller Tax ID: 12-3456789
```
leah_legal: looks like ACME's procurement requires exact entity match. Two options: (1) have ACME update their PO to match the entity on the marketplace, or (2) we add an alias mapping in the portal (requires partner team & legal approval). I prefer alias mapping for speed but need legal signoff on entity alias + attestation.
mike_billing: Finance needs the W-9 or VAT docs matching the billing entity before we accept invoice. If we add alias, finance still needs documentation to map payment. :+1:
harry_sales: ACME is on a hard go-live date next week. Short-term workaround: we can accept a direct invoice and mark the marketplace PO as pending, but sales needs approvals (risk = non-compliant procurement flow). Thoughts?
sophia_partnerships: Acme procurement is refusing to reissue PO. They're pushing marketplace-only flow. Can partnerships request alias mapping from marketplace ops? Who owns that?
james_fpna: I'll loop in marketplace-ops. @leah_legal can you draft a one-paragraph attestation we can send to marketplace ops to justify alias mapping? I'll hold on finance docs request until we hear back.
leah_legal: drafting now. Will include scope narrowness and timebox (30 days). Posting in channel when ready. :memo:
